acceptanceCriteria: ReadManifest and ReadReceipt use the bounded regular-file reader; a FIFO with no writer is refused inside a deadline in a test.
body: PR #1064 bounded the --shard-plan read (STR-V0-055), but internal/sessiontest ReadManifest and ReadReceipt still use plain os.Open, so a FIFO or oversized file at those paths can hang or exhaust memory. Suspected from code reading, not reproduced.
title: sessiontest ReadManifest/ReadReceipt open files with plain os.Open (FIFO hang class of V1-1613)
